summary: Partner Agreement System full E2E test — backend (26/26 pass) + frontend. Found and fixed 2 critical backend bugs: GET /api/partners/agreements/{id} missing w9_status/w9_file_url/w9_uploaded_at/custom_terms/commission_duration fields; GET /api/partners/agreements (list) missing w9_status field. After fixes: all flows working rock solid.

critical.issue: FIXED — Response was missing w9_status, w9_file_url, w9_uploaded_at, custom_terms, commission_duration fields. Admin detail page depends on w9_status to show W-9 panel state correctly.
FIXED — List response was missing w9_status field. Admin agreements list page uses w9_status for W-9 status badges (Verified/Awaiting Review/Pending).

minor.issue: Duplicate route decorator (@router.post decorator applied twice on line 671-672). Doesn't cause functional failure in FastAPI but is a code smell.

create_default_templates() function references DEFAULT_RESELLER_TEMPLATE, DEFAULT_REFERRAL_TEMPLATE, DEFAULT_COMMISSION_TIERS which are undefined. Would cause NameError on fresh DB with no templates. Non-critical since templates already exist in DB.

issues: List items with inline bold (e.g., `**Referral Partner:**`) render the `**` markers literally. renderMarkdown() doesn't process inline bold within list items.
Italic markdown (`*(text)*`) not rendered — shows literally as `*(Referral & Reseller Program)*` instead of italic text.

action_items: Fix create_default_templates() — add missing DEFAULT_RESELLER_TEMPLATE, DEFAULT_REFERRAL_TEMPLATE, DEFAULT_COMMISSION_TIERS variables (or inline content). Required for fresh DB deployments.
Optional: Fix renderMarkdown() in public signing page to handle inline bold within list items and italic text for better agreement readability.
Remove duplicate @router.post decorator on sign_agreement (line 671-672 in partners.py).
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL BUG FIXED: get_agreement() was not returning w9_status/w9_file_url/w9_uploaded_at/custom_terms/commission_duration — admin detail page W-9 panel and commission section depended on these fields
CRITICAL BUG FIXED: list_agreements() was not returning w9_status — admin list W-9 badge logic never worked until now
LATENT BUG: create_default_templates() references undefined DEFAULT_RESELLER_TEMPLATE, DEFAULT_REFERRAL_TEMPLATE, DEFAULT_COMMISSION_TIERS. This would NameError on fresh DB.
CODE SMELL: Duplicate @router.post('/agreements/{agreement_id}/sign') decorators on lines 671-672
MINOR: renderMarkdown() in public signing page doesn't handle italic (*text*) or inline bold within list items
